scope: Native sandboxed Debug QA application observations on macOS 27. No minimum-system or real purchase/restore acceptance.

environment.qa_entitlement_note: In-memory QA eligibility for file conversion; not a purchase, restored entitlement, or change to production capacity.

native_quit_ui_followup.change: Allow normal application termination while presenting the file-task sheet on macOS 15.4+; cancellation and cleanup run through AppDelegate.

one_gib.oracle: OpenCC 1.4.2 CLI on bounded independently delimited unit and tail; unit repetition checked

native_quit.path_redaction: Only the local username/container prefix was replaced with $QA_CONTAINER; relative temporary names and raw record SHA256 are retained.

operator_observations.basis: Native UI actions observed and recorded by the executing agent in this session; these are operation notes, not machine-derived timings.

save_panel_cancel.result: Canceling NSSavePanel returned without starting conversion or replacing the editor draft/result.

replace_existing_destination.result: Native overwrite confirmation accepted; completed output matched the recorded full expected SHA256.

task_cancel.target_size_basis: Manual native operation record; size is not present in native-cancel.json.
task_cancel.result: Existing target and the editor draft/result remained unchanged.

finder_reveal.result: The completed file was revealed in Finder.

multi_window.result: A second window could not start another file task while busy; closing an unrelated window did not cancel the owning window task.

normal_quit.result: Command-Q exited after cleanup, removed observed partial output and its directory, and preserved the previously completed 1 GiB destination.

pro_gate_without_qa_entitlement.result: Importing the approximately 16 MiB file presented the Pro prompt. Canceling retained the default editor source.
pro_gate_without_qa_entitlement.boundary: Only the locked-feature prompt was checked; no real purchase, restore, or offline entitlement was tested.

standard_quit_menu.result: The standard OpenCCman > Quit menu exited after cancellation cleanup; observed partial file and directory were removed, and the existing destination SHA256 was preserved.

owner_window_close.action: Command-W while the file-task modal sheet was visible
owner_window_close.result: The window and modal sheet stayed open, so this action did not exercise owner-window close cancellation.
owner_window_close.coverage: Owner-close lifecycle cancellation is covered by the core coordinator regression only.

qa_argument_autoimport.result: A bare QA auto-import argument did not grant sandbox permission; reading failed with Operation not permitted.
qa_argument_autoimport.boundary: Native file panels granted access and were used for the successful import/save/replace evidence. No automatic-import success is claimed.

ui_memory.method: ps -p <QA application PID> -o rss=; KiB multiplied by 1024. Nominal 100 ms sleep plus ps execution time.
ui_memory.raw_note: 100 ms ps RSS sampling across native save/cancel/complete UI validation; Debug QA app; not a Release throughput measurement
ui_memory.scope: Native save/cancel/complete flow, including idle time, in Debug. Not isolated conversion throughput, not the Release service benchmark, and not a worst-case memory guarantee.
